games.drama: At four in the morning something swept through both instruments in a fifth of a second, climbing in pitch, and then stopped. You are the detector scientist on shift, which means the noise, the templates and the mass ledger all come through you.
concepts: A dark fringe is where a tiny path difference is most visible
Every noise source has its own frequency band, and the sum has a minimum
Energy leaving the orbit is why the frequency rises
One observable across two masses fixes a combination
Consistent with is the claim a coherent match supports

games.title: The Noise That Would Not Go
games.course: Cosmology · how an unwanted signal turned out to be the early universe
games.place: A hilltop radio site: a twenty-foot horn on a concrete pier inside a ring of ground shielding, a receiver hut under it, and a much newer building up the ridge.
games.drama: There is a hiss coming out of the sky and it will not go away. You are the radio astronomer on the site, which means the checks, the sky sweep and the arithmetic all come through you.
concepts: An unexplained signal is an instrument problem until it survives the checks
A foreground is separated by where it is, not by how strong it is
The wavelength a thermal spectrum peaks at gives its temperature
A framework is judged by what it has to add to explain the same thing
One explanation that accounts for every clue at once

games.title: No Middle To It
games.course: Astronomy · how a relation between distance and recession became an expanding universe
games.place: A 1920s mountain observatory: years of glass in numbered drawers on one side of the corridor, a spectrograph on its own pier on the other, and one plot at the end of it.
games.drama: Every faint nebula anybody has taken a spectrum of is running away from us, and nobody can say why. You are the observer who has been given both sets, which means the ladder, the shifts and the plot all come through you.
concepts: A longer-period variable star is intrinsically brighter
Anything that makes a star look brighter makes it look closer
One line is an identification; several lines agreeing is a redshift
The slope with no structure left in the leftovers is the law
Uniform expansion has no middle to be standing at

games.title: Hospital Heroes
games.course: Anatomy & physiology
games.place: A children's hospital ward — a spine with rooms off it, and everything a size larger.
games.drama: You are a new doctor at the children's hospital. Today is your first day on the ward.
concepts: Levels of organisation: cells, tissues, organs, systems
Heart and circulation
Hormones and growth
Joints and how far they move
Imaging: X-rays and pictures of the inside
